title: Contx.eth
tagline: The context layer of Ethereum, turning an X / Twitter profile into an AI identity in 30 seconds
description:
Transform your X / Twitter profile into an AI-aware context identity in 30 seconds

**contx.eth** creates AI-enhanced ENS profiles by analyzing an X (Twitter) account and storing rich context in .contx.eth domains. This enables personalized AI interactions across any platform that supports ENS lookups.

### 🎯 Value Proposition
- **30-second setup**: From X profile to AI-enhanced ENS 
- **Universal compatibility**: Works with Claude, ChatGPT, and future AI agents
- **Self-sovereign**: You own your AI context on-chain
- **Base L2 optimized**: Low gas fees and instant transactions
- **Complete resolution**: Forward and reverse lookup with custom registry
how_its_made:
Frontend Foundation
- Next.js 15 with App Router for modern React patterns
- TypeScript for complete type safety across the stack
- Tailwind CSS 4 + Styled Components for Apple-inspired UI
- Framer Motion for smooth animations and transitions

Web3 Integration
- Privy for seamless Web3 + social authentication
- wagmi + viem for type-safe Ethereum interactions
- @ensdomains/ensjs for ENS operations
- Base Sepolia L2 for low-cost, fast transactions

AI & Data Pipeline
- OpenAI GPT-4o for intelligent profile analysis
- TwitterAPI.io for real Twitter data fetching
- Custom AI prompt engineering for Web3-optimized context generation
